card.name: Web page navigation and link text
card.fires_on: Words in web-page furniture such as 'Learn more about', 'PDF', 'FAQ', and the colon after a Q in a Q&A list. It also fires at sentence breaks before a link or section title.

modes.label: Link prompts
modes.description: Words in 'Learn more about' style calls to action or after-link text.

modes.label: Document labels
modes.description: File-type or document-name words like PDF, Brochure, FAQ, Diagram.
modes.example: Download the Open Government Partnership Brochure (<<PDF>>) - Data.gov-in-a-Box

modes.label: Q&A and section breaks
modes.description: The colon after Q or the full stop just before a new heading or list item.
